description: This Java class 'ContentFiles' functions as a form data wrapper for uploading content files within a web admin interface, managing multipart files and their associated metadata.

classes.name: ContentFiles
classes.description: A Serializable Java bean used for handling uploaded content files and their metadata in a web admin context.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the list of uploaded MultipartFile objects.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of MultipartFile objects.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with the file upload.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the file name for the upload.
